summary: Config-only follow-up verification (iteration 10). Verified .gitignore reordering, full backend regression suite (147/147 pass), Vercel deploy fixes still intact, yarn build chunk sizes, live /api/health + seeded QA login, and bcrypt hash format. No application code was modified.

minor.issue: CORS_ORIGINS defaults to '*' while allow_credentials=True — invalid per CORS spec; browsers reject credentialed wildcard requests. Works today only because the app uses Bearer tokens (no cookies).
No brute-force lockout / rate limiting on failed login attempts.
Token is base64(user_id:hmac) with no expiry/nonce; the 'Your session has expired' 401 message is misleading since tokens never expire and cannot be revoked.

critical_code_review_comments: Set CORS_ORIGINS to explicit origins (or set allow_credentials=False) so the wildcard+credentials combination is not shipped to production.
Consider adding token expiry (exp claim / JWT) and login rate limiting before public launch — currently signed tokens are valid forever.

rca_of_the_issue: Iteration 9's 5 failures were caused by gitignore last-match-wins semantics: an appended block with `*.env`/`.env.*` came after the `!frontend/.env` / `!backend/.env` negations, re-ignoring both env files. Moving the negations to the end of /app/.gitignore (lines 41-42) resolves it; verified via git check-ignore and the previously-failing tests in test_iter5_gitignore_envfiles.py and test_iter8_deploy_smoke.py::TestEnvFilesNotGitIgnored now pass.
